ValidationRule.description: Active projects must pass a launch-readiness gauntlet: code format, ISO-week parity, calendar span, burn rate, tags-per-priority, regulated contacts and a risk/completion balance.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Active'), NOT(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(End_Date__c)), OR( NOT(REGEX(BLANKVALUE(Code__c, '-'), 'PRJ-[0-9]{4}-[0-9]{4}-[A-Z]{2}')), AND(MOD(ISOWEEK(Start_Date__c), 2) = 1, NOT(Is_Approved__c)), End_Date__c - Start_Date__c < CEILING(NULLVALUE(Duration_Secs__c, 0) / 86400), ROUND(NULLVALUE(Spent__c, 0) / MAX(1, NULLVALUE(Budget__c, 0)), 2) > MIN(1, MAX(0.05, (TODAY() - Start_Date__c) / MAX(1, End_Date__c - Start_Date__c))) + 0.15, CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 2, 'High', 1, 0) > PICKLISTCOUNT(Tags__c), AND(INCLUDES(Tags__c, 'Regulated'), OR(ISBLANK(Contact_Email__c), ISBLANK(Phone__c))), ABS(NULLVALUE(Risk_Score__c, 0) - 10 * (1 - NULLVALUE(Completion_Pct__c, 0))) > 7 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Active project failed the launch-readiness checks.
